an6.23:1.1: Bhayan ti bhikkhave kāmānam etaṃ adhivacanaṃ, dukkhan ti bhikkhave kāmānam etaṃ adhivacanaṃ, rogo ti bhikkhave kāmānam etaṃ adhivacanaṃ, gaṇḍo ti bhikkhave kāmānam etaṃ adhivacanaṃ, saṅgo ti bhikkhave kāmānam etaṃ adhivacanaṃ, paṅko ti bhikkhave kāmānam etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
an6.23:2.1: Kasmā ca bhikkhave bhayan ti kāmānam etaṃ adhivacanaṃ? Kāmarāgarattāyaṃ bhikkhave chandarāgavinibbaddho diṭṭhadhammikā pi bhayā na parimuccati, samparāyikā pi bhayā na parimuccati. Tasmā bhayan ti kāmānam etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. Kasmā ca bhikkhave dukkhan ti . . . rogo ti . . . gaṇḍo ti . . . saṅgo ti . . . paṅko ti kāmānam etaṃ adhivacanaṃ? Kāmarāgarattāyaṃ bhikkhave chandarāgavinibaddho diṭṭhadhammikā pi paṅkā na parimuccati, samparāyikā pi paṅkā na parimuccati. Tasmā paṅko ti kāmānam etaṃ adhivacanan ti.
an6.23:3.1: Bhayaṃ dukkhaṃ rogo gaṇḍaṃ saṅgo paṅko ca ubhayaṃ: ete kāmā pavuccanti, yattha satto puthujjano.
an6.23:4.1: Upādāne bhayaṃ disvā jātimaraṇasambhave anupādā vimuccanti jātimaraṇasaṃkhaye.
an6.23:5.1: Te khemappattā sukhino diṭṭhadhammābhinibbutā sabbaverabhayātītā sabbadukkhaṃ upaccagun ti. XXIV.
